decks.notes: The main idea of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo of Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create a 20/20 flying indestructible Marit Lage token. This combo can be facilitated by cards like Crop Rotation and Green Sun's Zenith to find the necessary pieces. The deck also includes various ways to protect the combo, such as Karakas and Boseiju, Who Endures. Overall, the deck aims to efficiently and effectively win the game through the Dark Depths combo while also having some disruption and card draw options.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through a combination of powerful control spells and efficient creatures. The deck aims to disrupt opponents' strategies while generating card advantage and value through cards like Teferi, Time Raveler, Sylvan Library, and Snapcaster Mage. Additionally, the deck utilizes powerful removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending to deal with opposing threats. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value and flexibility in playing the long game and outlasting opponents.

The deck focuses on using aggressive creatures like Bonecrusher Giant, Goblin Rabblemaster, and Legion Warboss to apply pressure early on, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Ensnaring Bridge and Trinisphere. It aims to lock down the opponent's spells with cards like Chalice of the Void and Blood Moon, while ramping up mana quickly with cards like Chrome Mox and Ancient Tomb. The deck also utilizes powerful burn spells like Fury and Shatterskull Smashing to finish off the game. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently.

This control deck aims to disrupt opponents with a variety of counterspells and removal spells while generating card advantage through cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Expressive Iteration. The deck also looks to control the board with sweepers like Supreme Verdict and generate value with cards like Life from the Loam and Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional card advantage and synergizes well with cards like Dress Down and Endurance. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's 4-5 color control strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly generate artifacts to power up various synergy effects with cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch, and Sai, Master Thopterist, while disrupting the opponent's game plan through cards like Chalice of the Void and Force of Will. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of efficient mana production, card draw, and disruptive elements, putting pressure on the opponent and controlling the game through artifact interactions. It seeks to create a strong board presence while maintaining flexibility and adaptability through its artifact-based strategy.

The main concept of this Aggro Dragon Stompy deck is to disrupt the opponent's mana base with cards like Blood Moon and Chalice of the Void, while also deploying aggressive threats like Legion Warboss and Goblin Rabblemaster to quickly close out the game. The deck aims to use fast mana acceleration from cards like Simian Spirit Guide and Chrome Mox to power out high-impact threats like Laelia, the Blade Reforged and Fireflux Squad. By combining disruptive elements with powerful creatures, the deck seeks to overwhelm opponents and secure victory through a combination of pressure and disruption.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through a combination of countering spells, removing threats, and disrupting the opponent's game plan. It aims to maintain board control and card advantage using powerful control spells like Force of Will, Swords to Plowshares, and Teferi, Time Raveler. The deck also utilizes card draw and selection with Brainstorm, Ponder, and Narset, Parter of Veils. Additionally, it includes disruptive cards like Hullbreacher and The Wandering Emperor to further hinder the opponent's strategies. Ultimately, this deck seeks to outlast the opponent and win through incremental advantage.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble a board of powerful artifacts and use them to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive strategies. The deck focuses on using cards like Urza's Saga, Mishra's Bauble, and Mox Opal to generate mana and card advantage, while also utilizing cards like Chalice of the Void and Force of Will to disrupt the opponent's game plan. By combining artifact synergy and aggro tactics, this deck aims to create a fast and efficient win condition against opponents in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly establish a board presence by playing artifact creatures and generating tokens, while controlling the opponent's plays with disruptive cards like Chalice of the Void and Pithing Needle. The deck also aims to generate card advantage through spells like Thoughtcast and Emry, Lurker of the Loch, while utilizing the mana acceleration provided by cards like Mox Opal and Lotus Petal. The inclusion of Urza's Saga allows the deck to tutor for key artifacts to further enhance its strategy. Overall, this deck prioritizes aggressive artifact-based plays with a control element.

This deck focuses on utilizing lands to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It relies on cards like Crop Rotation, Life from the Loam, and Exploration to search for key lands like Urza's Saga, Dark Depths, and Thespian's Stage to generate value and create powerful combos. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Sphere of Resistance and Rishadan Port to slow down the opponent's plays. Overall, the deck aims to control the battlefield through its powerful land interactions and versatile toolbox of cards.

The deck focuses on assembling the Dark Depths combo by using cards like Crop Rotation, Knight of the Reliquary, and Elvish Reclaimer to quickly find and assemble the combo pieces. It also includes utility lands like Karakas and Bojuka Bog to disrupt opponent strategies while cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Sylvan Library provide additional consistency. The deck also has a toolbox element with cards like Endurance and Ramunap Excavator to provide flexibility and resilience in various matchups. Overall, the deck aims to quickly develop its board and win the game with the powerful Dark Depths combo.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counter spells, removal, and efficient creatures like Murktide Regent and Dragon's Rage Channeler. Stoneforge Mystic helps tutor up powerful equipment like Batterskull and Kaldra Compleat to provide additional threats and value. The deck also includes cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder to filter through the deck and find key pieces. With a solid manabase of dual lands, the deck aims to outvalue opponents and disrupt their game plan while building its own board presence.

The main idea of this deck is to apply continuous pressure on the opponent with early aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while also utilizing disruptive spells like Daze and Force of Will to protect your threats. The deck aims to tempo out the opponent by efficiently controlling the board and using cards like Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning to finish off the opponent quickly. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive playstyle with a mix of fetch lands and dual lands to ensure a consistent mana base.

The main focus of this deck is to maintain a fast and aggressive tempo, utilizing efficient creatures like Murktide Regent and Delver of Secrets. By supplementing these threats with disruptive spells like Force of Will and Daze, the goal is to maintain control while applying pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes card selection spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to ensure consistency in draws. The mana base is tailored to support this strategy, with access to Wasteland for land disruption and a mix of fetchlands and dual lands for color fixing.

This UWx Control deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. It utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Jace, the Mind Sculptor to maintain control of the battlefield and outvalue opponents. The deck also includes efficient removal like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending, as well as versatile spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to find key cards. With a mix of control elements and powerful threats, this deck aims to disrupt opponents' strategies while setting up its own win conditions.
